text:
This guidance is relevant to cases of employment which began on or after 29 February 2008 where a breach of the illegal working requirements took place before 16 May 2014. Use this guide to find out:

the law on illegal working

your role and duty as an employer

the document checks you should carry out

images of the various documents you could be given

the various types of immigration statuses held by people

the consequences if you do not carry out document checks and you are found employing an illegal worker
